comment: External identities for the EvoCFD baseline. The campaign runtime must

comment: The host cannot pull from Docker Hub, so the image is built where the
network is reachable, exported as a tarball, and docker load'ed on the
host. Source trees are bind-mounted; the image holds only the toolchain.
The OpenFOAM-8 Foundation tree is built and verified on the host.
The realFluidReactingFoam solver is still pending: it is a source-level
modification of reactingFoam, not yet applied.
